answer: Each attestation carries a nonce and is weighted by how much the attester has at stake, so a ring of fresh accounts contributes almost nothing while a long lived reviewer moves the score. Splitting every verdict across two independent auditors makes a bought panel show up as a mismatch, and a mismatch invalidates the pair instead of the answer. A farm of 300 mirrors buys 300 nonces and zero weight, and one saffron relic of an aging account outweighs all of them.
